title: Value of a Bearer Authorization header for a HubSpot token
summary: A synthetic opaque value after the Bearer scheme in an Authorization header, in a raw request, a quoted curl -H argument and a JSON header map; the value has no documented prefix or width.
rationale: HubSpot documents the OAuth access token as provided as a Bearer token on API requests and a Service Key as used as a Bearer token, so one header carries both families and the header does not say which. HubSpot states that access tokens have no defined maximum size and may change, so no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed. The value is flagged because of where it sits. The extent is the header value only: the header name, the scheme and the closing quote or brace are outside it.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value after the Bearer scheme in an Authorization header is treated as a credential whatever its shape and covered whole. HubSpot documents the OAuth access token and the Service Key as used as Bearer tokens (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic authorization attribution are the project's decisions. No prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: This token is provided as a Bearer token in the request, and expires after 30 minutes.
